population.kidComparison: Bangladesh is one of the world's most populated nations, home to about 175.7 million people.

geography.climate: Subtropical to warm temperate climate, ranging from sunny coasts to dry inland areas.
geography.terrain: Mix of coastal plains and inland terrain.

anthem.title: National Anthem of Bangladesh
anthem.summary: The official patriotic anthem played at national ceremonies in Bangladesh.

exploration.didYouKnow: Bangladesh is located in Southern Asia and its capital city is Dhaka.
